reviews.text: Great experience! They helped me get my ankle back to feeling good and back to running. Super knowledgeable, supportive, and would definitely recommend!

I had surgery to repair my torn labrum and bicep tendinitis last spring. After my initial therapy through another facility, I was not recovering as anticipated. I then had a shoulder manipulation and decided to see Matt for my next round of therapy. What a difference! From day 1, Matt put together a program that was different from my initial therapy and really got to know me not only as a patient but a person. The program was challenging and pushed me to my limits without pushing me over the edge. I highly recommend Matt for any therapy needs you may need.
